summary: Open and nonempty, contained in a compact set.

steps.lean:
volume (F.floorValues a x y) ≠ ∞ := ⟨(isOpen_floorValues.preimage (.prodMk_right (x,
  y))).measure_ne_zero _ ⟨0, 0, by simp [ball_spec]⟩, (((F.ball_spec.2.2.preimage_smul x⁻¹).image
  (by fun_prop)).measure_ne_top <| measure_mono_top (image_mono fun _ ↦ (subset_closure ·.1.1)) ·)⟩
steps.claim: The set is open (a slice of isOpen_floorValues) and contains 0 (w = 0, as 0 ∈ 𝔅_F), so its Haar measure is nonzero; it lies in the image of the compact closure of x·𝔅_F under w ↦ w(e*_a), so its measure is finite.
